reported.title: No debounce: bounce and noise produce multiple toggles per press
reported.description: The loop reads the raw pin and calls flipLamp() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 50-56) with no settle/debounce window, so each bounce edge toggles the lamp again. Measured evidence shows a single press toggling D11 11 times (bounce scenario 4 times, rapid presses 3 times), and spurious toggles with no press at 401 ms and 1.40 s. The spec requires a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge, which is entirely absent. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [11, 11, 11, 11]. D11 also toggled 40 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 401 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
